table_description: Transactional sales records of retail orders across the United States between 2014 and 2017.

columns.name: row_id
columns.description: Unique integer identifier for each transaction line item in the database.

columns.name: order_id
columns.description: Unique alphanumeric order number. Multiple items in the same purchase share the same order_id.

columns.name: order_date
columns.description: Date when the order was placed in ISO-8601 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Use strftime('%Y', order_date) for year and strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) for month.

columns.name: ship_date
columns.description: Date when the order was shipped in ISO-8601 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

columns.name: ship_mode
columns.description: Shipping class: 'Standard Class', 'Second Class', 'First Class', or 'Same Day'.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each customer. Use COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) to calculate unique customer counts.

columns.name: customer_name
columns.description: Full name of the individual customer.

columns.name: segment
columns.description: Customer market segment: 'Consumer', 'Corporate', or 'Home Office'.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Country where the customer is located (United States).

columns.name: city
columns.description: City where the order was delivered (e.g. New York City, Los Angeles).

columns.name: state
columns.description: State of delivery (e.g. California, New York, Texas).

columns.name: postal_code
columns.description: US ZIP code stored as text to preserve leading zeros.

columns.name: region
columns.description: Geographical sales region: 'West', 'East', 'Central', or 'South'.

columns.name: product_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the product item.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Top-level product category: 'Furniture', 'Office Supplies', or 'Technology'.

columns.name: sub_category
columns.description: Product sub-category (17 total): 'Chairs', 'Tables', 'Bookcases', 'Furnishings', 'Binders', 'Paper', 'Storage', 'Art', 'Appliances', 'Labels', 'Envelopes', 'Fasteners', 'Supplies', 'Phones', 'Accessories', 'Machines', 'Copiers'.

columns.name: product_name
columns.description: Full product title/description.

columns.name: sales
columns.description: Monetary gross revenue for the line item in USD ($).

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Number of units purchased in this order line.

columns.name: discount
columns.description: Discount rate applied as a decimal between 0.0 (0%) and 0.8 (80%).

columns.name: profit
columns.description: Net monetary profit or loss in USD ($). Can be negative for unprofitable transactions.

business_metrics.description: Percentage ratio of net profit relative to total sales revenue.
Average elapsed time in days between order placement and shipment.
Filter or having condition identifying items where total profit is negative.
